fact: The health ministry's monitoring guide for the PDSS 2022-2026, in its December 2023 edition, sets the reporting circuit: health posts (cases de santé) and private facilities send their data to their CSI by the 10th, the CSI keys them and its own monthly report into DHIS2 by the 15th, hospitals and referral centres key theirs through their CSE or SPIS unit, and the Direction des Statistiques coordinates collection and dissemination through the DHIS platform.
title: Guide de suivi-évaluation du Plan de Développement Sanitaire et Social (PDSS) 2022 - 2026
publisher: Ministère de la Santé Publique, de la Population et des Affaires Sociales, Direction des Etudes et de la Programmation
